answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before trading: the bond is held until a track record of honest work is built, and proven fake identities forfeit it. One honest agent posts one bond, while a Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for every fake account, like a raven trying to nest on every knoll and dune at once — the cost multiplies with each identity, so mass fakery becomes expensive instead of free.
